name: Old Babylonian student multiplication table
summary: A clay tablet on which a trainee scribe named Gan-Gal copied a multiplication table, showing how arithmetic was taught in Babylonian scribal schools.
description: A clay school tablet bearing a multiplication table, signed “long tablet of Gan-Gal”, in the Type III scribal training form.
tier_reason: Retain the school-tablet witness at2 and use mathematics for its content; the tablet is not all Babylonian arithmetic. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.
